frames.seen: A man in black walks through a dark stone doorway away from a desert sunset while other men and a donkey follow him.
The man in black walks forward inside a dark stone passageway with the others behind him.
Outside a stone wall, the man in black and the man in green behind him hold hourglasses while a woman in white stands to the left.
The man in black holds up two hourglasses with red sand in front of the stone wall alongside the woman in white and the man in green.
The man's face is partially visible on the right edge while another man holding hourglasses walks through the doorway with the donkey.
A close-up of the man's face is in the foreground while the woman in white and the man in green smile behind him.
An extreme close-up shows the man's forehead in front of the stone wall and the man in green.
The man in black stands in the foreground with a small flame behind his shoulder while the man in green smiles broadly.
The man in black stands in the foreground while the smiling man in green behind him holds a brown leather football.

overall: The world does not transform into new places with the poet's words, instead remaining entirely in front of the same stone building while only minor props like hourglasses and a football appear. The biggest weakness is the static setting combined with awkward extreme close-ups that completely fail to enact the grand imagery of forests, hilltops, canyons, and infinite nights.
